reason: The mascot idea is charming, but I'd try the free plan and see whether visitors even click it. I'm not paying for a chat widget until I've seen it earn its keep on my own site.
objection: Another monthly subscription for something visitors might ignore. I don't know if the animation looks truly on-brand or like a generic widget, and I don't trust an AI answering and acting on my site without seeing it handle real traffic.
would_change_my_mind: A live demo on a site like mine showing visitors engaging with it, real conversion numbers from a comparable SaaS, and enough design control to make the mascot clearly mine and not a template.
